value: Our Schools — Little Seeds & Peter Pan Schools

Our campus on Santa Clara Avenue is a warm, light-filled environment designed to spark wonder at every turn. From our mud kitchen in the garden to our art studio stocked with real materials, every corner invites exploration.
A nurturing, low-ratio environment where the youngest learners develop trust, sensory awareness, and early communication in a home-like setting.
Toddlers are naturally driven to explore and assert independence. Our studio gives them safe boundaries to climb, create, and communicate.
Project-based learning inspired by Reggio Emilia, where children investigate real questions through art, science, storytelling, and dramatic play.
Kindergarten-readiness skills woven into rich play experiences. Children build literacy, numeracy, and executive function while having the time of their lives.
